primaryTextRead.text: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
